run_plot_tsv: run plot.py on a TSV log file to generate a terminal plot of episode returns
run_plot_csv_with_errorbars: run plot.py on a CSV file with the --errorbars flag to show error bars
run_plot_with_smoothing: run plot.py with --smoothing cumsum to apply cumulative sum smoothing to the data
run_plot_multiple_files: run plot.py with multiple file patterns to overlay plots from different log files
run_plot_custom_keys: run plot.py with --xkey and --ykey flags to plot custom column names from a log file
